title: R2 pin 1 is not connected to +5V
ask: Please connect R2 pin 1 to +5V (the track from C1 to R1 is the nearest +5V).
ideal: Both LED resistors are fed from the same +5V track.
signal: +5V supply, a few mA for the LED. 0.3 mm or wider.
background: The router left this one open: the short way runs between R1 and D1.

title: C1 is now 0805 (was 0603)
ask: Nothing to do; this reports a change.
background: 10 µF in 0603 loses most of its capacitance at 5 V; 0805 keeps more of it.

title: Mark the LED colours on the silkscreen
ask: If there is room, please add "R" and "G" beside D1 and D2. It is fine to leave it as it is.
ideal: The colour of each LED can be read on the board.
